senses.gloss: זִבֵּל (denom. of זֶבֶל) to deposit foliage in the field for manure, to manure.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 3:2">Shebi. III, 2</cite> <he>עד כמה מְזַבְּלִין</he> how many piles may be deposited? <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:2">Ib. II, 2</cite> <he>מְזָבְּלִין וכ׳</he> you may manure &c.
Keth. 10ᵇ the rain waters ומְזַבֵּל and softens (corresp. to מוג, Ps. LXV, 11, cmp. בּוּל II).
Cant. R. to I, 1 אנחנו לא נְזַבֵּל וכ׳ (not נזבלים) should we not improve (our minds) even as those carrying out foliage and straw?; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְזוּבָּל manured.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:2:2">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵇ</cite>

senses.gloss: , Nithpa. נִזְדַּבֵּל to be manured. Midr. Sam. ch. IV.—
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 49a:2">Ab. Zar. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>שדה שנִזְדַּבְּלָה וכ׳</he> a field which has been manured with material connected with idolatry (foliage from a worshipped tree &c.).
